title: ihave_push/mbox: duplicate NNTP IHAVE send code — extract shared send_ihave helper
description: ihave_push.rs:send_ihave() and mbox.rs:mbox_send_ihave() are functionally identical: both open TCP, read greeting, send IHAVE, handle 435/335, dot-stuff article, send, read final code. The only differences are the return type enum names (SendResult vs IhaveSendResult). Both live in the import/ subtree. This duplication means any NNTP protocol fix (e.g. 436 retry handling) must be applied twice. Extract a shared send_ihave function in import/mod.rs or a new import/nntp_client.rs.
